kind: Bounded credential/publication check, not an exhaustive security audit

scan.scope: Only explicitly selected original evidence; bounded publication check, not exhaustive security scan

rawPreservation: All 202 selected originals copied byte-for-byte; every failure/control and all original reports/manifests retained. No silent rewriting.

generatedAPITokenHandling.generation: Each independent API driver creates a disposable local token via container.repos.apiKeys.create; the token is held in memory and used only as a Bearer request header.
generatedAPITokenHandling.recording: The driver HTTP log records method/path/status/response body/authenticated flag, not request headers. Repository sqlite/settings.ts generates gg_ plus 24 random bytes encoded as 32 base64url characters and persists its SHA-256 hash, not token plaintext.
generatedAPITokenHandling.verification: All selected files scanned for the exact generated gg_ token shape and literal Bearer values, in addition to provider/GitHub/AWS/private-key patterns; zero candidates. Declared disposable stores/executable remain local, and their current hashes were verified.
